mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the tile with a weight gave the assembly a purpose and showed how its response changed under load.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the cradled tile was straightforward but less interesting on its own than seeing the test work.

surprise.text: The tile rising without a propeller or balloon was a striking departure from the earlier real-world mechanisms, even though the introduction made clear that it was invented science.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the preparations led clearly to a contained test, though several were routine.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the fictional lift tile is used in the fair, especially given the need to control and tether it.
